profileSubtitle: How your name, language and numbers appear.
securitySubtitle: Your password, two-step verification and signed-in devices.
changePasswordHint: You'll be signed out on every device, including this one.
passwordChanged: Password changed. Sign in again with the new one.
mfaOffBody: Ask for a code from an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator, each time you sign in.
mfaOnBody: Signing in asks for a code from your authenticator app.
mfaScan: Scan this with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
mfaManual: Can't scan? Enter this key instead:
mfaDisableBody: Enter your password and a current code.
mfaNoRecovery: Keep your authenticator app safe. If you lose it, you can't sign in until someone with database access helps.
stepUpBody: Enter a current code from your authenticator app to continue.
